summary: 15 features and 13 fixes across HagiCode-org/hagicode-core, HagiCode-org/web.
bodyHtml:
Features

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • sessions: add configurable post-state actions (1b9a3e0)
  • config: default frontend theme to spring-dark (c613164)
  • config: add persisted tablet mode setting (1e4715f)
  • codex: send chat images as inline CLI inputs (a594065)
  • codex: keep interactive question ids unique per session (adc894f)
  • codex: support interactive user questions (340c472)
  • config: add Codex interactive-control setting (4d71ebe)

HagiCode-org/web

  • vault: create a unified vault browsing workbench (3e115c3)
  • settings: configure post-state session actions (86708b8)
  • tablet: add task and proposal workspace operations (463f06c)
  • tablet: add preference-driven tablet workspace (67fdc1c)
  • salary-tracker: add animated earnings water level (4964e94)
  • settings: add Codex CLI interactive-control option (f516329)
  • proposal: split repository cards into reference and edit zones (37028a9)
  • i18n: add edit zone tooltip to proposal locales (f24b10a)

Fixes

HagiCode-org/hagicode-core

  • achievements: persist and forward achievement progress (30f972c)
  • config: update completed notification sound (bc3b33f)

HagiCode-org/web

  • hero: shrink stacked avatars in compact selection cards (ff83b3a)
  • skills: improve local table at compact widths (2edf81d)
  • layout: improve controls at compact viewport widths (b63299a)
  • proposal: hide access hints after selecting a repository (e155d39)
  • layout: preserve actions at compact widths (c5df79f)
  • achievements: report successful actions once (e6385d8)
  • kanban: size lanes from the board container (a58f587)
  • hydration: keep reminder timers scheduled (0a8a546)
  • notifications: update completed sound selection (d191490)
  • proposal: distinguish repository access role colors (3a075c9)
  • theme: default to dark before the app loads (fa6f17f)
